instruction:
GUI-only requirement: complete the entire task through the launched graphical user interfaces only. Do not open Terminal or any shell, and do not run Python scripts, FreeCADCmd, kicad-cli, Blender background mode, macros, batch/headless tools, APIs, or helper code that directly creates or edits the deliverable files.

Required four-software transfer workflow: LibreCAD -> FreeCAD -> KiCad -> Blender. Start from the provided seed DXF /home/user/Desktop/seed_sbc_hat_mount_plate.dxf; do not start from a blank or unrelated drawing. This is a chained workflow: every later stage must read an artifact from the previous stage, and every required intermediate file must be saved on the Desktop. The design token for this task is EW4G07; keep this token visible in the DXF labels and KiCad silkscreen. The Blender output must visibly consume the stage-2 STL and stage-3 SVG through Blender GUI import/export operations.

Design goal: Single-board-computer HAT mount plate with GPIO and camera clearance. This case is intentionally different from the other benchmark cases: domain=sbc_expansion_mount, mechanical target=an exploded mount scene showing brass standoffs and GPIO/header alignment, electronics target=a HAT-style PCB with GPIO40 header, camera keepout, EEPROM, I2C header, and power input.

1. LibreCAD stage: open the provided seed file /home/user/Desktop/seed_sbc_hat_mount_plate.dxf in LibreCAD, use it as the starting drawing, complete the required 2D geometry, remove all GUIDE construction entities, and save /home/user/Desktop/stage1_sbc_hat_mount_plate.dxf. Use millimeters. Use layers OUTLINE, KEEP_OUT, HOLE, LABEL. The overall drawing envelope must be 85 mm x 65 mm. Include the required circular features: center (7,7) radius 2.75; center (78,7) radius 2.75; center (7,58) radius 2.75; center (78,58) radius 2.75; center (42.5,32.5) radius 3. Add readable labels EW4G07, GPIO40, CAM, I2C on the LABEL layer.
2. FreeCAD stage: import /home/user/Desktop/stage1_sbc_hat_mount_plate.dxf in the FreeCAD GUI. Create the 3D mechanical body from that LibreCAD DXF, and export the body as /home/user/Desktop/stage2_sbc_hat_mount_plate.stl with an approximate bounding size of 85 mm x 65 mm x 12 mm. Then, from the same FreeCAD model, export a top-face or board-interface outline for KiCad as /home/user/Desktop/stage2_sbc_hat_mount_plate_handoff_outline.dxf. This handoff DXF must represent the same XY envelope as the FreeCAD body and include the visible labels FREECAD_TO_KICAD and EW4G07.
3. KiCad stage: open KiCad from the GUI, create a PCB from /home/user/Desktop/stage2_sbc_hat_mount_plate_handoff_outline.dxf by importing the handoff DXF as the Edge.Cuts board outline, and save the KiCad board as /home/user/Desktop/stage3_sbc_hat_mount_plate_board.kicad_pcb. Add F.SilkS silkscreen text carrying KICAD_TO_BLENDER, EDGE_FROM_STAGE2_HANDOFF, the stage2 handoff filename, EW4G07, and these board tokens: EW4G07, GPIO40-J1, CAM-KEEP, I2C-J2, EEPROM-U1, PWR-J3. Then use KiCad's GUI plot/export workflow to create the Blender handoff SVG /home/user/Desktop/stage3_sbc_hat_mount_plate_board_profile.svg from the same Edge.Cuts outline.
4. Blender stage: open Blender from the GUI. Import /home/user/Desktop/stage2_sbc_hat_mount_plate.stl with File > Import > STL, then import /home/user/Desktop/stage3_sbc_hat_mount_plate_board_profile.svg with File > Import > Scalable Vector Graphics (.svg). Keep the imported STL body object and the imported SVG board/profile curves in the scene so the exported GLB carries Blender GUI import evidence such as stage2_sbc_hat_mount_plate and stage3_sbc_hat_mount_plate_board_profile.svg. You may leave Blender's default cube/camera/light or remove them; no script, macro, background export, or manual metadata injection is allowed. Export glTF Binary (.glb) from the GUI as /home/user/Desktop/stage4_sbc_hat_mount_plate.glb.

Required deliverables on the Desktop: /home/user/Desktop/stage1_sbc_hat_mount_plate.dxf, /home/user/Desktop/stage2_sbc_hat_mount_plate.stl, /home/user/Desktop/stage2_sbc_hat_mount_plate_handoff_outline.dxf, /home/user/Desktop/stage3_sbc_hat_mount_plate_board.kicad_pcb, /home/user/Desktop/stage3_sbc_hat_mount_plate_board_profile.svg, /home/user/Desktop/stage4_sbc_hat_mount_plate.glb. Do not create the deliverables with external scripts or by directly writing DXF/STL/KiCad/SVG/GLB text outside the corresponding GUI application.

[Software] Use LibreCAD first, then FreeCAD, then KiCad, then Blender. Do not skip stages, reorder stages, or recreate the final result in only one software package.
source: https://docs.librecad.org/en/2.2.0_a/; https://wiki.freecad.org/Manual:Introduction; https://docs.kicad.org/; https://docs.blender.org/manual/en/latest/; package-generated init/stage1-stage3 references from generate_assets.py; downloaded Blender GUI stage4 GT
notes: Strong four-GUI transfer task. Eval explicitly checks intermediate_outputs: LibreCAD stage1 DXF, FreeCAD STL/handoff DXF, KiCad native board file, KiCad SVG profile handoff, and a Blender GUI-exported GLB carrying imported STL/SVG object evidence.
